---
title: "EDA of LSST Light Curve"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggridges)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(glue)

theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}
lc_raw <- read_csv(
  file = here("data_raw", "lc.csv"),
  col_types = "ccfnnnnlllllln"
)
glimpse(lc_raw)
```

```{r}
(object_id_str <- lc_raw$diaObjectId[1])
```

```{r}
lc_df <- lc_raw |>
  select(y_nJy = psfFlux, y_se_nJy = psfFluxErr, band, t_MJD = MJD) |> 
  mutate(t_0 = t_MJD - min(t_MJD),
         band = factor(band, levels = c("u", "g", "r", "i", "z", "y")),
         d = as.integer(band)) |> 
  arrange(t_0, band)

head(lc_df)
```

```{r}
lc_df |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t_MJD, y = y_nJy, colour = band) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = band, shape = band), size = 2, colour = "black") +
  geom_rug(sides = "b", position = "jitter", alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 21:25)) +
  labs(
    title = glue("diaObjectId = {object_id_str}"),
    x = "Time [MJD]",
    y = "PSF direct image flux [nJy]",
    colour = "Band", fill = "Band", shape = "Band"
  )


```

```{r fig.height=6}
lc_df |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t_MJD, y = y_nJy, colour = band) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = band, shape = band), size = 2, colour = "black") +
  geom_rug(sides = "b", position = "jitter", alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 21:25)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(
    ymin = y_nJy - 2 * y_se_nJy,
    ymax = y_nJy + 2 * y_se_nJy
  )) +
  facet_wrap(
    facets = vars(band),
    ncol = 1,
    strip.position = "right"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number()) +
  labs(
    title = glue("diaObjectId = {object_id_str}"),
    x = "Time [MJD]",
    y = "PSF direct image flux [nJy]",
    colour = "Band"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
lc_df |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = y_nJy, y = band, fill = band, colour = band) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number_auto()) +
  labs(
    title = glue("diaObjectId = {object_id_str}"), x = "PSF direct image flux [nJy]", y = "Band"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
lc_df |>
  group_by(band) |>
  summarise(
    mean_y = mean(y_nJy),
    sd_y = sd(y_nJy),
    mean_se = mean(y_se_nJy)
  )
```

```{r}
# Add z-transformed columns (standardised within bands)
lc_df <- lc_df |>
  mutate(
    y_std = as.numeric(scale(y_nJy)),
    y_se_std = y_se_nJy / sd(y_nJy), 
    .by = band
  )
lc_df
```

```{r}
lc_df |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t_0, y = y_std, colour = band) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = glue("diaObjectId = {object_id_str}"),
    x = "Time [days]",
    y = "Standardised flux",
    colour = "Band"
  )
```

```{r}
write_rds(lc_df, file = here("data", "lc_df.RDS"))
write_csv(lc_df, file = here("data", "lc_df.CSV"))
```
